releaseNotes:
• AI Provider UX Polish: Seamless smooth appearing animation and automated viewport scrolling when selecting any AI provider
• Smart Scroll Clamping: Prevents redundant or runaway scrolling by anchoring to the initial input card reveal and capping at the ideal view offset
• Provider Readiness Assurance: Explicit 'Not Ready' status verification for unconfigured providers with instant reactive state synchronization
• Direct Tap Target: Tapping anywhere on a provider row instantly selects it and brings up the API key input card
